summary: On August 28, 2026, Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP), through subsidiary Mott's LLP, entered definitive agreements with Chobani to sell its entire indirect equity interest in Chobani for $800 million—$400 million cash at closing plus a $400 million promissory note maturing December 26, 2026. Separately, KDP sold certain assets, including leasehold interests in two Allentown, PA facilities, for $125 million. The transactions, expected to close in Q3 2026 subject to customary conditions, reflect KDP's exit from its Chobani stake. Proceeds may support deleveraging. Watch for closing timing and completion of the note payment.
